import gurobipy as gp
import json

products = ["A", "B", "C"]
periods = [1, 2, 3, 4]

demand = {
    "A": [8, 12, 10, 14],
    "B": [10, 8, 14, 12],
    "C": [6, 9, 7, 11],
}
prod_cost = {
    "A": [9, 11, 10, 12],
    "B": [8, 9, 11, 10],
    "C": [13, 12, 14, 11],
}
setup_cost = {"A": 45, "B": 40, "C": 50}
holding_cost = {"A": 2, "B": 3, "C": 2}
hours_per_unit = {"A": 2, "B": 3, "C": 4}
min_lot = {"A": 4, "B": 4, "C": 3}
initial_stock = {"A": 0, "B": 0, "C": 6}
capacity = [90, 95, 90, 100]

model = gp.Model("multi_period_production")

x = {}
y = {}
I = {}

for i in products:
    for idx, t in enumerate(periods):
        x[i, t] = model.addVar(vtype=gp.GRB.INTEGER, name=f"x_{i}_{t}")
        y[i, t] = model.addVar(vtype=gp.GRB.BINARY, name=f"y_{i}_{t}")
        I[i, t] = model.addVar(lb=0, vtype=gp.GRB.INTEGER, name=f"I_{i}_{t}")

model.update()

obj = gp.quicksum(
    prod_cost[i][idx] * x[i, t]
    + setup_cost[i] * y[i, t]
    + holding_cost[i] * I[i, t]
    for i in products
    for idx, t in enumerate(periods)
)
model.setObjective(obj, gp.GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Inventory balance
for i in products:
    for idx, t in enumerate(periods):
        prev = initial_stock[i] if idx == 0 else I[i, periods[idx - 1]]
        model.addConstr(I[i, t] == prev + x[i, t] - demand[i][idx], name=f"inv_{i}_{t}")

# Final inventory zero
for i in products:
    model.addConstr(I[i, 4] == 0, name=f"final_{i}")

# Setup forcing
for i in products:
    total_prod = sum(demand[i]) - initial_stock[i]
    for idx, t in enumerate(periods):
        model.addConstr(x[i, t] <= total_prod * y[i, t], name=f"setup_ub_{i}_{t}")
        model.addConstr(x[i, t] >= min_lot[i] * y[i, t], name=f"setup_lb_{i}_{t}")

# At most two products per period
for idx, t in enumerate(periods):
    model.addConstr(gp.quicksum(y[i, t] for i in products) <= 2, name=f"max_setup_{t}")

# Total stock capacity
for idx, t in enumerate(periods):
    model.addConstr(gp.quicksum(I[i, t] for i in products) <= 20, name=f"stock_cap_{t}")

# Capacity hours
for idx, t in enumerate(periods):
    model.addConstr(
        gp.quicksum(hours_per_unit[i] * x[i, t] for i in products) <= capacity[idx],
        name=f"capacity_{t}",
    )

model.optimize()

    gp.GRB.INFEASIBLE: "INFEASIBLE",
    gp.GRB.UNBOUNDED: "UNBOUNDED",
    gp.GRB.INF_OR_UNBD: "INF_OR_UNBD",

}

    objective = 0.0
    variables = {}

print("SOLUTION_JSON=" + json.dumps({"status": status, "objective": objective, "variables": variables}))
